optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT sr.sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           sr.sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
           SUM(sr.SR_FEE) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns sr
    INNER JOIN date_dim dd
            ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY sr.sr_customer_sk, sr.sr_store_sk
)
SELECT c.c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ctr2.ctr_store_sk,
           AVG(ctr2.ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS ctr_avg_return
    FROM customer_total_return ctr2
    INNER JOIN store st
            ON ctr2.ctr_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    WHERE st.s_state = 'TN'
    GROUP BY ctr2.ctr_store_sk
) AS store_avg
        ON store_avg.ctr_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
INNER JOIN store s
        ON s.s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
INNER JOIN customer c
        ON c.c_customer_sk = ctr1.ctr_customer_sk
WHERE s.s_state = 'TN'
  AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > store_avg.ctr_avg_return
ORDER BY c.c_customer_id
LIMIT 100
